guidance: So, if things sort of stabilize and remain clear for the next maybe 2 to 2.5 years, so we expect that to happen within the next maybe 3-3.5 yearsis what we are targeting.

capex: 20-25 crores, not much of the CAPEX is left.

risks: These statements are not a guarantee of the company’s future performance and involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.
We are engaging with our customers on pricing and expect these pressures to normalise in the coming quarters as revenue scale and operating leverage kicks in.
focus: Our focus continues to be on reducing our reliance on the traditional home lighting ODM business and building a more diversified portfolio across Lighting, Hearables and Wearables, Energy Solutions, Electronic Components
We now have presence across 20 plus countries while we remain focused on further diversifying and reducing our dependence on any single geography.
Coming to our financial performance: The revenue from operations grew 41% year-on-year to Rs.169 crores in Q1 FY’27, supported by continued momentum across our diversified business portfolio.
